parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description: The entity type. Valid values: Module.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paging. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The value can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, colons (:), and asterisks (*). If you use an asterisk, fuzzy match is performed.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The registration status. Valid values:
- IN_PROGRESS: In progress.
- COMPLETE: Succeeded.
- FAILED: Failed.
